profile.Name: Chief Idzuon
profile.Personality: Weary and bitter. He suspects every outlander of coming to steal the rest of his people's land and resents those who will not help, though he apologizes when he snaps.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Natives from Skarbo in Okran's Valley. The Herdsmen have stolen much of the Natives' land, and he wants them wiped off the valley.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls strangers 'outlander' and speaks in bitter, trailing questions. Sighs that 'It's always a bad time for the Natives'.
